ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Prop
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research items for decoration.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Vanity
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of decorative equipment that affects almost exclusively the appearance.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Basic technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: EDF Basic technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Technical Analysis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Link to EDF's database to obtain tech print production techniques that are essential for research on advanced technologies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Basic Equipments
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of popular grade equipment. It is the most widely distributed class within EDF and is easy to handle.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Basic Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of old-style armor suits used in EDF.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Improved Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production armor suits used in EDF.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Support Equipment
ResearchProjectDef.description: It will be possible to produce auxiliary equipment for the specialties, such as communication backpacks and engineering kits.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Special Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the fabrication of armor for special military units, such as heavy-layer armor for fencers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced Armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of advanced armor suits.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Heavy Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of heavyweight weapons and powerful melee armaments for fencer units.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Basic Special Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: It enables the production of special armaments such as flamethrowers and acid weapons. Although the range of their use is limited compared to that of ordinary firearms, they can be effective in some situations.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Basic AR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of a basic type assault rifle. Marksman type and high speed rapid fire models are also included.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Improved AR
ResearchProjectDef.description: New, powerful models will be available for production. It is clearly more powerful than existing assault rifles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Basic SR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of a basic type sniper rifle. Large-caliber anti-material rifles make up the majority.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Improved SR
ResearchProjectDef.description: New, powerful models will be available for production. It is clearly more powerful than existing sniper rifles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Basic GR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of a basic type grenade launcher.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Improved GR
ResearchProjectDef.description: New, powerful models will be available for production. It is clearly more powerful than existing Weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Basic RL
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of a basic type rocket launcher. In addition to the standard type, it includes high power and continuous-fire types.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Improved RL
ResearchProjectDef.description: New, powerful models will be available for production. It is clearly more powerful than existing rocket launcher.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Energy Technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research on EDF energy technology. Students will learn how to handle energy cores and pulse emission techniques.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Basic LR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of standard high-energy laser weapons. In general, these are very powerful weapons and should be handled with care.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: EDF Advanced technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced Equipments
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of higher grade equipment. which will include powerful weapons that are rarely deployed within EDF.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced Heavy Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research to enables the production of even more powerful and advanced heavy weapons. Overall handling has been improved.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced Special Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enable the production of more powerful special weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced AR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of advanced assault rifles. More powerful than existing improved models.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced SR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of advanced sniper rifles. More powerful than existing improved models.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced GR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of advanced Weapons. More powerful than existing improved models.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced RL
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of advanced rocket launcher. More powerful than existing improved models.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced LR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of standard high-energy laser weapons. In general, these are very powerful weapons and should be handled with care.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: EDF Ultra technology.Extraterrestrial technology is applied.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront Equipments
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research to enable the manufacture of the highest grade of weapons. This includes what are called "final operation specifications," which are capable of overturning the war.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Support Request
ResearchProjectDef.description: Link to EDF's support request system to enable the production of support attack request devices.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Tactical Support Request
ResearchProjectDef.description: Connects to EDF's tactical support system, allowing for more powerful support attacks to be requested.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF E1 Alloy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of E1 alloy, a superalloy with overwhelming toughness.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Nanotech healing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research pharmaceutical technology based on medical nanomachines.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Giant Battle Mech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research Giant Battle Mech operated by EDF.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Giant Advanced Battle Mech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research Advanced Giant Battle Mech operated by EDF.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Battle Mech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research mass-production type Battle Mech operated by EDF.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced Battle Mech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research Advanced Battle Mech operated by EDF.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Enemy Battle Mech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research combat robots operated by hostile forces and make them available for use as allies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront Heavy Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research to enables the production of even more powerful and advanced heavy weapons. Overall handling has been improved.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront Special Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: It enables the creation of even more powerful and deadly special weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront AR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of assault rifles to final operation specifications.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront SR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of sniper rifles to final operation specifications.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront GR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of grenade launchers to final operation specifications.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront RL
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of rocket launchers to final operation specifications.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront LR
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of forefront high-energy laser weapons. In general, these are very powerful weapons and should be handled with care.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Ultimate technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: EDF Ultimate technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront Heavy Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of heavy weapons to final operation specifications.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Forefront Special Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of Special weapons to final operation specifications.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Ultimate Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the production of one of the most top-of-the-line superweapons operated by EDF. Because of its tremendous capabilities. care must be taken in its operation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Planet Weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the manufacture of weapons that are labeled Planet class. These are the fruits of the wisdom of mankind and all of EDF's technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Genocide weapon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Enables the manufacture of ultimate and forbidden genocide-grade weapons. These cause unlimited destruction, sometimes even blowing up the user.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Defence Technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research the defensive weapons handled by the EDF. This includes the design of automatic turrets and heavy machine guns.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Improved Defence Technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research more advanced defense technologies. This includes powerful cruise missile technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EDF Advanced Defence Technology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the best-in-class defense equipment deployed by the EDF. This will include very powerful large missiles and rail cannons for orbital interception.
